## Checklist

- [ ] My branch is rebased on the latest `master`.
- [ ] `gofmt -s -w .` produces no diff on my changes.
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes.
- [ ] `go test ./...` passes locally.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where it made sense.
- [ ] I updated user-facing docs (`README.md`, route table, env vars) if behaviour changed.
- [ ] New source files include the SPDX header (`SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0`).
- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) and agree to license my contribution under **Apache License 2.0**.
- [ ] I followed the [Code of Conduct](../docs/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
